name: 状態の解除候補と指定日時
prompt:
Correct candidate 1 while preserving its exact Japanese copy and blue selected time treatment. Use the original source crop for geometry and the native preview for the final 390×382 target.

The source crop excludes the app header: no title. Keep these seven options, in order: 「解除しない」, 「30分後」, 「1時間後」, 「4時間後」, 「今日」, 「今週」, 「日時を指定」. Align their text to the left and their radio circles on the right. Candidate 1 spreads the lower rows too far down. Set row centers around y=28, 69, 110, 151, 192, 233, 274 on the 390×382 target. Keep the bottom date/time pills at y≈329 as shown in the native preview.

Widen the picker card to the full source width: x=138, y=93, width=230, height=203. Candidate 1's card is too narrow. Keep the neutral gray selected band at x≈154, y≈177, width≈198, height≈34. Selected center values remain 「12」 | 「00」 | 「午後」; nearby values are 「10」 | 「00」 | 「午前」, 「11」 | 「30」 | 「午前」 above and 「1」 | 「30」 | 「午後」, 「2」 | 「00」 | 「午後」 below.

At the bottom, show 「6月4日」 in dark text and 「12:00」 in blue (#1685ff). Keep the selected 「日時を指定」 radio blue. Blue appears only on these two selected cues; all other option and date text stays dark.

Maintain the source's lightly dimmed list, translucent white rounded time-picker card, subtle fades, gray pill surfaces, and the 390×382 native preview canvas. No extra chrome, footer, branding, header, or unrelated text. Static image only.
reviewNotes: Candidate 2 preserves exact Japanese labels and values, the blue 12:00 text requested by the user, and the blue selected custom radio. The picker card remains narrower than the source, and the final option row is lower than source placement after two attempts. Keep needs-correction.
